passages.title: Later school start times
passages.body:
A district moved middle-school start times from 7:30 a.m. to 8:45 a.m. Tardiness dropped by thirty percent in the first semester, and nurses logged fewer morning headaches. The superintendent claimed the later bell directly improved student health.

Researchers noted the same year introduced free breakfast in the cafeteria and a phone-lock policy during homeroom. They also pointed out that families with early work shifts still struggled to arrange drop-offs, so attendance gains were uneven across neighbourhoods.

questions.prompt: The researchers' comments most directly suggest the attendance and health improvements —
choices: might reflect several simultaneous changes, not just the later bell alone
prove teenagers need no sleep
show breakfast causes headaches
mean phone locks harm health
questions.answer: might reflect several simultaneous changes, not just the later bell alone

questions.prompt: The superintendent treats reduced tardiness chiefly as evidence that —
choices: later start times benefit students
nurses should start school earlier
breakfast should be removed
phones improve punctuality

questions.prompt: Which study design would best test whether the later bell alone caused fewer headaches?
choices: Compare similar schools where only start times differ while holding breakfast and phone policies constant
Survey students about favourite subjects
Measure cafeteria noise levels
Ask families to wake up earlier
questions.answer: Compare similar schools where only start times differ while holding breakfast and phone policies constant

questions.prompt: Statement: "Only students who complete the safety quiz may use the workshop tools." Priya is using the drill press. What follows logically?
choices: Priya completed the safety quiz
Priya dislikes quizzes
No one completed the quiz

questions.prompt: Advertisement: "Our sneakers make you faster because Olympic athletes wear them." The flaw is closest to —
choices: assuming a product must be good because famous people use it
measuring speed with a stopwatch
designing shoes in multiple sizes
testing shoes on a track
questions.answer: assuming a product must be good because famous people use it

questions.answer: Amir and I were planning to submit the report until the Wi‑Fi did not work
